name: openexam-hub
description: Free, official-source study roadmaps for language exams (TEF Canada, TCF, IELTS, TOEFL, CELPIP, Goethe, DELE). Vite + React frontend, Vercel Node functions, Firestore.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/test-blog.mjs --built && node scripts/test-clb.mjs --built && node scripts/test-compare.mjs --built && node scripts/test-crs.mjs --built && node scripts/test-cefr.mjs --built && node scripts/test-i18n.mjs --built
scripts.test: node scripts/test-http.mjs && node scripts/test-client-helpers.mjs && node scripts/test-orchestrator.mjs && node scripts/test-learner-agents.mjs && node scripts/test-ledger.mjs && node scripts/test-usage.mjs && node scripts/test-algo.mjs && node scripts/test-v3.mjs && node scripts/test-blog.mjs && node scripts/test-worker.mjs && node scripts/test-signup-alert.mjs && node scripts/test-auth-gate.mjs && node scripts/test-user-emails.mjs && node scripts/test-funding-prerender.mjs && node scripts/test-hits.mjs && node scripts/test-clb.mjs && node scripts/test-compare.mjs && node scripts/test-crs.mjs && node scripts/test-cefr.mjs && node scripts/test-i18n.mjs
scripts.test:account: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-openexam --config firebase.json "node scripts/test-account-emulator.mjs"
scripts.test:signup-alert: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-openexam --config firebase.json "node scripts/test-signup-alert-emulator.mjs"
